constraint.selector:
selector:
  select:
    options:
      - value: raise_only
      - value: lower_only
      - value: absolute
    mode: dropdown

hvac_mode.selector:
selector:
  select:
    options:
      - value: keep
      - value: cool
      - value: heat
      - value: dry
      - value: fan_only
      - value: auto
    mode: dropdown

climate_entity.selector:
selector:
  entity:
    multiple: true
    filter:
      domain: climate

opening_entities.selector:
selector:
  entity:
    multiple: true
    filter:
      - domain: binary_sensor
        device_class: window
      - domain: binary_sensor
        device_class: door
      - domain: binary_sensor
        device_class: opening

pause_action.selector:
selector:
  select:
    options:
      - value: none
      - value: turn_off
    mode: dropdown
